title: LIBD spatial data browser
intro: Spatial transcriptomics and snRNA-seq datasets from the Lieber Institute for Brain Development, viewable in the browser without any installation.

datasets.name: Human amygdala
datasets.description: Visium, Visium HD and Xenium sections of human amygdala with spatial domains, cell types and cell boundaries.

datasets.name: Human dACC
datasets.description: Visium sections of the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex with cortical layer labels, and paired snRNA-seq with Azimuth cell types, across ten donors.

datasets.name: Amygdala across species (snRNA-seq)
datasets.description: Basolateral amygdala nuclei from human, rhesus macaque and baboon with conserved fine cell type labels; one UMAP per species and broad cell class.
